title: This Claude Hack Can Cut Your AI Costs in Half
description:
Everyone is talking about AI agents, but this might be one of the most powerful Claude tools we've seen yet. 🚀

Imagine having 50 AI agents working on a task at the same time.

✅ One agent plans the project
✅ One writes the code
✅ One runs tests
✅ One checks for security issues
✅ All of them share memory and collaborate in parallel

The best part? It automatically routes simple tasks to cheaper models and only uses premium models for complex work, helping you reduce token costs while getting faster results.

It's completely FREE and open-source, takes just a few minutes to set up, and can dramatically improve your AI workflow.

Here’s how to set it up:

1. Copy the Ruflo GitHub repo link.
2. Paste it into Claude Code and tell it to set it up.
3. Give it a task and watch it split across multiple agents.
4. Agents plan, code, and test in parallel while sharing context.
5. Basic tasks route to cheaper models automatically so only the hard stuff hits Opus.

link: https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo
